**A [[Suicide attack|suicide bomber]] kills four people and injures over 100 others in a [[car bomb]] attack in [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/afghanistan-blast-rocks-eastern-kabul-district-reuters-190114144830784.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Saha Airlines Boeing 707 crash]]
**A [[Boeing 707]] cargo plane crashes into a building in [[Karaj]], [[Iran]], after overshooting the runway during its landing. Officials confirm that of 16 people on board, 15 are killed and one is injured. No casualties are reported on the ground. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-46861324 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Paweł Adamowicz]], the [[List of mayors of Gdańsk|Mayor of Gdańsk]], [[Poland]], dies in hospital of stab wounds after an attack at a charity event the night before. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/14/gdansk-residents-donate-blood-stabbed-mayor-pawel-adamowicz (''The Guardian'')]
*Robert Lloyd Schellenberg, a [[Canadians|Canadian]] in [[China]], is sentenced to death after a one-day retrial for attempting to [[Drug trafficking|smuggle]] over 222 kilograms (489.4 pounds) of [[methamphetamine]] through the country. Schellenberg's new sentence comes amid [[Canada–China relations|increasing tensions between Canada and China]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/01/14/asia/china-canadian-drugs-death-sentence-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.foxnews.com/world/canadian-sentenced-to-death-in-china-for-drug-smuggling-amid-tensions-between-countries.amp (Fox News)]
